title: The Bailey-Matthews Shell Museum

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: For grades K-12 the Museum offers onsite field trips, online sessions, and the Mollusks on the Move outreach program in which educators visit schools with live mollusks. All offerings align with Florida Sunshine State education standards and can be adapted for Home School groups and summer camps. The donor-funded Adopt-A-Class program provides funds for Title 1 schools, and other schools as resources permit, to access these programs at no cost and may also subsidize the cost of bus transportation to and from the Museum. We bring the mollusks to your classroom! This hands-on experience introduces students to mollusks’ anatomy, growth, diet, life cycles, and their role in the ecosystem.

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The aquariums and galleries of the Museum offer a unique and memorable setting for private events. Flexible space options for groups of up to 125 can accommodate cocktail parties, meetings, and celebrations such as birthday, retirement, and engagement parties. While the Museum does not have a catering kitchen, small dinners are also possible.
